         """Encodes a string into tokens.
 
         Special tokens are artificial tokens used to unlock capabilities from a model,
@@ -109,6 +111,17 @@ class Encoding:
         >>> enc.encode("<|endoftext|>", disallowed_special=())
         [27, 91, 437, 1659, 5239, 91, 29]
         ```
+
+        If `compress` is True, adjacent repeated tokens are collapsed into a single token
+        after encoding.
+
+        If `return_positions` is True, returns a tuple `(tokens, positions)` where `positions[i]`
+        is the index of the character in `text` at which token `i` starts.
+
+        ```
+        >>> enc.encode("hello world", return_positions=True)
+        ([31373, 995], [0, 5])
+        ```
         """
         if allowed_special == "all":
             allowed_special = self.special_tokens_set
@@ -121,7 +134,7 @@ class Encoding:
                 raise_disallowed_special_token(match.group())
 
         try:
-            return self._core_bpe.encode(text, allowed_special)
+            tokens = self._core_bpe.encode(text, allowed_special)
         except UnicodeEncodeError:
             # BPE operates on bytes, but the regex operates on unicode. If we pass a str that is
             # invalid UTF-8 to Rust, it will rightfully complain. Here we do a quick and dirty
@@ -130,7 +143,31 @@ class Encoding:
             # string, but given that this is input we want to support, maybe that's okay.
             # Also we use errors="replace" to handle weird things like lone surrogates.
             text = text.encode("utf-16", "surrogatepass").decode("utf-16", "replace")
-            return self._core_bpe.encode(text, allowed_special)
+            tokens = self._core_bpe.encode(text, allowed_special)
+
+        if return_positions:
+            positions = self._token_start_positions(tokens)
+            if compress:
+                tokens, positions = _compress_tokens_with_positions(tokens, positions)
+            return tokens, positions
+
+        if compress:
+            tokens = _compress_tokens(tokens)
+        return tokens
+
+    def _token_start_positions(self, tokens: Sequence[int]) -> list[int]:
+        """Returns the starting character index in the source text of each token.
+
+        If a token starts in the middle of a multi-byte character, the index of that character
+        is used.
+        """
+        text_len = 0
+        positions = []
+        for token in tokens:
+            token_bytes = self._core_bpe.decode_single_token_bytes(token)
+            positions.append(max(0, text_len - (0x80 <= token_bytes[0] < 0xC0)))
+            text_len += sum(1 for c in token_bytes if not 0x80 <= c < 0xC0)
+        return positions
 
     def encode_to_numpy(
         self,
@@ -437,3 +474,27 @@ def raise_disallowed_special_token(token: str) -> NoReturn:
         f"by passing `disallowed_special=(enc.special_tokens_set - {{{token!r}}})`.\n"
         "To disable this check for all special tokens, pass `disallowed_special=()`.\n"
     )
+
+
+def _compress_tokens(tokens: list[int]) -> list[int]:
+    """Removes adjacent repeated tokens from a token sequence."""
+    if not tokens:
+        return tokens
+    compressed = [tokens[0]]
+    for token in tokens[1:]:
+        if token != compressed[-1]:
+            compressed.append(token)
+    return compressed
+
+
+def _compress_tokens_with_positions(
+    tokens: list[int], positions: list[int]
+) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]]:
+    """Like `_compress_tokens`, keeping the start position of the first token in each run."""
+    compressed: list[int] = []
+    compressed_positions: list[int] = []
+    for token, position in zip(tokens, positions):
+        if not compressed or token != compressed[-1]:
+            compressed.append(token)
+            compressed_positions.append(position)
+    return compressed, compressed_positions
